stem: A heavy block is to be dragged along a rough horizontal floor. To do so, a person A pushes at angle of 30° with the horizontal and requires a minimum force of F<sub>A</sub> while the person B pulls the block at an angle of 60° with the horizontal and needs a minimum force of F<sub>B</sub>. If the coefficient of friction between the floor and block is $\sqrt{3}$ /5, then the ratio of F<sub>A</sub> and F<sub>B</sub> is?

assets.alt: Two blocks on a floor: one pushed by F_A at 30° below the horizontal, N = mg + F_A sin 30°; the other pulled by F_B at 60° above the horizontal, N = mg − F_B sin 60°.
